How to rotate pdf online

  1. Choose a PDF with pages that need turning.
  2. Select all pages or enter the specific page numbers.
  3. Choose a rotation, then save the corrected PDF.

Rotations apply relative to the current page orientation. Signed PDFs and some interactive forms may be affected when saved again.

Fix scanned and sideways PDF pages

Scans and mobile phone documents sometimes have the wrong orientation. You can rotate a whole document, or target only the incorrectly oriented pages. For example, rotate pages 1, 4 and 6 clockwise by 90 degrees while leaving every other page unchanged.

The tool updates the PDF page rotation. It does not rephotograph or rasterize each page. This usually keeps text selectable, but edited PDF files should always be checked when they contain forms or digital signatures.

Frequently asked questions

Can I rotate only page 2?

Yes. Select Specific pages and enter 2.

Will rotation alter the page content?

The page is rotated without turning it into an image. Review complex PDFs after saving.
